card.name: Radiation and radiopharmaceutical wording
card.fires_on: Words and word parts in radiation or radiopharmaceutical text, where a word like radiation or radioactive is likely to come next. Examples are dos-im-etry, radi-oph-armaceuticals, MBq units and radiation dose tables.

modes.label: Inside radiopharmaceutical terms
modes.description: Partway through long words such as dosimetry or radiopharmaceuticals.

modes.label: Activity units and dose numbers
modes.description: Parts of radioactivity amounts such as MBq, or the space before a radiation dose table.

modes.label: Nuclear accident and counting context
modes.description: Ordinary words in text about radiation levels or measuring radioactivity.
